inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A wide strip of a pixel art game background: a high plateau above a sea of white clouds. Across a deep gap stands a pale lavender flat topped hill, and on it, seen from far away, is the settlement of the Clarth, a tribe of desert hunters who hunt the giant sand shark. Everything they build is made from the bones and hide of that shark: a great hall built inside a giant bleached shark skull, its open jaws the doorway, red hides hung on it; a tall watchtower of lashed bone with a red hide roof at the hill's corner over the gap; tents of red hide stretched over bone frames; red banners with a white horn sign on bone poles; a low fence of curved ribs along the far edge. Everything on the hill is small with distance, seen from far across the gap, with clear readable silhouettes against the white clouds behind it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "a real lived in settlement seen from afar, coherent pixel clusters, depth and scale, readable silhouettes", "lighting": "Clear cold morning sun from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes.", "color_palette": ["#2a6ab8", "#bfe0f4", "#ffffff", "#6a88b0", "#d4c4a4", "#b0a084", "#7c7480", "#ece4ee", "#a898b8", "#b03a30", "#701f20", "#e2d6ba", "#a89880"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A distant hill top with its settlement, seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, clouds behind it, no people.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 470, 1000], "desc": "a sea of white clouds far behind and below, with a few pale blue mountain peaks"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [463, 0, 867, 937], "desc": "the pale lavender flat top of the hill, bare wind scoured stone"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [683, 582, 867, 940], "desc": "the blue shadowed stone face of the hill's edge"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [316, 28, 750, 312], "desc": "the great hall of the Clarth inside a giant bleached sand shark skull, its open jaws the doorway, red hides hanging on it, the biggest building"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [705, 0, 867, 269], "desc": "small tents of red hide over shark bone frames, a red banner on a bone pole"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [536, 625, 683, 767], "desc": "small tents of red hide over shark bone frames"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [169, 732, 691, 826], "desc": "a tall watchtower of lashed shark bones with a red hide roof"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [867, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "the near edge of the warm tan stone plateau in the foreground, in shadow"}]}}
